# Who owes you rent, and how old is it?

> Free analyzer for small landlords: load your rent ledger and see who owes what and how old it is, which units pay late, monthly collection rate and a late-fee upper bound. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
